name: Star Trek: The Original Series
description: The first Star Trek television series featuring the crew of the USS Enterprise.

name: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
description: The first Star Trek film released in theaters, continuing the adventures of the USS Enterprise.

name: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
description: A highly regarded Star Trek film featuring the return of the villain Khan Noonien Singh.

name: Star Trek: The Next Generation
description: The second Star Trek television series set approximately 100 years after the original series.

name: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
description: The third Star Trek television series set on a space station near a newly discovered stable wormhole.

name: Star Trek: Voyager
description: The fourth Star Trek television series featuring the adventures of the USS Voyager stranded in the Delta Quadrant.

name: Star Trek: Enterprise
description: The fifth Star Trek television series set before the original series, showcasing the early days of human space exploration.

name: Star Trek (2009)
description: A reboot of the Star Trek film franchise, featuring a new cast portraying the original series characters in an alternate timeline.

name: Star Trek: Discovery
description: The sixth Star Trek television series set approximately a decade before the events of the original series.

name: Star Trek: Picard
description: A Star Trek television series featuring the return of Captain Jean-Luc Picard, set two decades after the events of Star Trek: Nemesis.
